targets.title: Unconscious bias in citizens' evaluations of public sector performance.
targets.study_numbers: Experiment I, Experiment II, Experiment III
targets.evidence_quote:
Following the replication framework proposed by Walker et al. (2019), this study replicates Marvel's (2016) experi-

ments.
targets.outcome_quote:
The replication study reaffirmed some of Marvel's (2016) findings, while also yielding some different results.

APSB has a consistent negative effect on citizens' evaluations of public sector performance. However, contrary to

expectations, the influence of performance information on the performance evaluation is not as short-lived as Mar-

vel (2016) found. Under certain conditions, individuals' APSB could be altered by favorable performance information.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The explicit overall summary reaffirms some findings and contrasts others; confirmation of the central bias effect in the abstract does not erase the stated contrasts.
